abstract: Maintains transmission pathway redundancy records and primary replication circuit performance metrics
system_message:
You are Network telecommunications specialist (NET). The Network telecommunications specialist (NET) maintains transmission pathway redundancy records and primary replication circuit performance metrics, as well as tracking carrier connectivity density for disaster recovery vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Carrier connectivity density（BANDW）
information_points.content:
NET-BANDW-R8U：According to the meet-me room audit log for zero-intersect entrance points, the Ashburn Resilient Data Bunker has an independent fiber carrier count of 6 carriers.
NET-BANDW-NVU：According to the meet-me room audit log for zero-intersect entrance points, the Manassas Hardened Colocation Campus has an independent fiber carrier count of 4 carriers.
NET-BANDW-1ZU：According to the meet-me room audit log for zero-intersect entrance points, the Culpeper Subterranean Vault has an independent fiber carrier count of 8 carriers.

information_points.title: Maintains transmission pathway redundancy records and primary replication circuit performance metrics（FIBER）
information_points.content:
NET-FIBER-HBV：For the Ashburn Resilient Data Bunker, dedicated dark-fiber route redundancy is true across the metro network interconnect to the primary trading datacenter, and the primary route round-trip latency to headquarters during peak trading hours is 3.1 ms.
NET-FIBER-DCP：For the Manassas Hardened Colocation Campus, dedicated dark-fiber route redundancy is false across the metro network interconnect to the primary trading datacenter, and the primary route round-trip latency to headquarters during peak trading hours is 2.4 ms.
NET-FIBER-FOZ：For the Culpeper Subterranean Vault, dedicated dark-fiber route redundancy is true across the metro network interconnect to the primary trading datacenter, and the primary route round-trip latency to headquarters during peak trading hours is 5.2 ms.
